text: The road is long and the saddlebags heavy, so I sent {what} ahead on the wind. May they find you before the candles burn low.
Somewhere a moonwell shimmers and a fox sleeps in the ferns. Here is a little of that quiet, folded into a parcel for you.
Dear {name}, autumn came early to my bags. I gathered what fell and sent it to you, the way rivers send leaves to the sea.
These were carried through rain and dusk and one very rude murloc. Hold them gently; every item remembers the hands it passed through.
I watched the sun sink behind the mountains and thought of you, {name}. The mailbox was the nearest thing to a wishing well.
Psst, {name}. The goblins watch the auction house, so {what} go by mail. Burn this letter. No wait, fire is also suspicious.
Do not trust the mailbox. It has a slot, and slots are how they listen. Contents enclosed anyway, because I have no better option.
Wake up! Copper ore is not mined, it is grown in secret vats under Ironforge. Enclosed: evidence. Also some extra goods, unrelated.
I have counted the gryphons over Stormwind three times and the number keeps changing. Sending {what} before they notice me noticing.
Every lockbox is a tiny vault built by someone who did not want you to open it. Ask yourself why. Then open it anyway and report back.
Per our earlier discussion, please find {what} attached. Kindly confirm receipt at your earliest convenience and log it in the bank ledger.
Hi {name}, quick sync: inventory restructuring is complete and these assets have been reallocated to your department. No action required.
MEMO: Bag space utilization exceeded 100 percent this quarter. Surplus materials are being transferred to you, effective immediately.
After a review of our vendor trash strategy, {what} were deemed high value. Please leverage them to drive synergy at the anvil.
Note that this transfer is non-refundable and the sender accepts no liability for any feelings of gratitude. Best regards, Logistics.
Once a humble merchant had more {what} than sense. He mailed them to a friend, and that friend became a legend. Your turn, {name}.
Hear the tale of a backpack so full it begged for mercy. Its owner, moved to pity, lightened the load into this very letter.
In a tavern by the docks I heard of a crafter named {name}, said to turn raw goods into wonders. I sent these to see if the stories are true.
A courier once crossed three zones on foot to deliver a single scroll. This parcel took the easy road, but the spirit of the tale remains.
The bards will sing of this day, {name}, or at least hum briefly. A parcel was sent, a mailbox chimed, and a hero got free stuff.
Here are {what}. They were in my bags. Now they are in yours.
Enclosed: items. I do not want them. You might. Statistically.
{name}, this is mail. You have received it. Congratulations on checking your mailbox.
I considered writing something heartfelt. Then I remembered postage costs the same either way. Enjoy the {what}.
Do not thank me. Do not reply. Just craft something and pretend it was hard.
